title: 2023 Panini Donruss Press Proof 051/100 Trey Lance - San Francisco 49ers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2023 Panini Donruss Press Proof trading card featuring Trey Lance of the San Francisco 49ers is a limited edition collectible with a print run of 051/100. This serial numbered card is part of the base set and offers a special parallel variety, making it a highly sought-after item for sports trading card collectors. Manufactured by Panini America, Inc., this original card showcases Trey Lance in his NFL uniform, making it a must-have for fans of the quarterback and the San Francisco 49ers.
